analyzed_vuln.description: In ASN template decoding, GetASN_StoreData handles ASN_DATA_TYPE_MP by calling mp_read_unsigned_bin() on attacker-controlled INTEGER content length without enforcing that the destination mp_int has enough digit capacity. In this build, the destination mp_int used for ECDSA verify (r/s allocated in wc_ecc_verify_hash with fixed size based on key bits) can be too small for oversized ASN INTEGERs, and sp_read_unsigned_bin writes past a->dp (heap-buffer-overflow at sp_int.c:17303). Root cause is missing size validation/rejection in ASN MP import path before reading into pre-sized mp_int.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger via wc_ecc_verify_hash on a malformed DER ECDSA signature (DecodeECC_DSA_Sig -> GetASN_Items). Provide ASN INTEGER(s) for r or s with encoded length larger than the allocated mp_int capacity for the selected ECC key (including cases with leading padding/oversized integers). Data flow: fuzz input becomes signature bytes -> DecodeECC_DSA_Sig template parser -> GetASN_StoreData(ASN_DATA_TYPE_MP) -> mp_read_unsigned_bin/sp_read_unsigned_bin, causing out-of-bounds write.
